q: The von Neumann algebra M = L∞(X) ⋊ Γ (crossed product) associated to an ergodic free action Γ ↷ (X,μ) is a complete invariant of:
opts: Not a complete OE invariant in general — Murray-von Neumann showed there are non-conjugate systems with isomorphic crossed products
exp: The crossed product L∞(X) ⋊ Γ is an OE invariant (if Γ ↷ X and Λ ↷ Y are OE, the crossed products are isomorphic). But it is not a complete invariant: non-OE actions can give isomorphic von Neumann algebras (the free group problem). Popa's deformation/rigidity theory separates many cases.
